rows.sentence: The 1.7B model behind our 8 GB numbers is not in the app's model catalog: catalog.json lists Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen3-4B but no Qwen3-1.7B (our reading of the maintainer's pre-release snapshot, not of RC1). On RC1 a request for the 1.7B failed with 'matches no installed model', and the only installed model was Qwen2.5-1.5B.
rows.recheck: runsheet row 0b: Model Catalog photo sha; strike if it lists Qwen3-1.7B or apk sha is not 2ef43258

rows.sentence: The app's evaluation hook answers in the Detailed style with a 1,024-work budget because it takes the style from personalities.json defaultId ('detailed'), not from the user setting (DeviceEvalRunner.kt lines 164 and 203; our reading of the maintainer's pre-release snapshot, not of RC1). On RC1, 50 of 51 answers ran Detailed at maxTokens 1024; the app moved one to Succinct by its own short-answer rule.
rows.recheck: none (eval-hook behaviour; the chat's own style is not measured here)

rows.sentence: The app searched only its built-in knowledge base: RC1's log reads 'knowledge base + 0 packs', and its Knowledge screen offers extra collections only as network downloads from its own catalog, none of them ours. The code has no route to add a .sqlite pack offline: a single MAIN/LAUNCHER intent filter, and the only file picker takes text, CSV, JSON and PDF notes (our reading of the maintainer's pre-release snapshot, not of RC1).
rows.recheck: runsheet row 0b: Knowledge and Model Catalog photo shas; strike if a boar-packs entry is listed

rows.sentence: The app has no 'may be wrong' line for answers that come from model memory: the warning text our engine prints occurs 0 times in the code and assets (our reading of the maintainer's pre-release snapshot, not of RC1). On RC1 the line appeared on 0 of the 3 questions where our bench engine shows it, and on 0 of 51 answers.

rows.sentence: Whether the app answers fact-table questions (population, height, dates and similar) with deterministic layers is not established: on RC1's evaluation hook the 8 such questions in the 51 all went to the 1.5B (176 to 424 generated tokens each), but that hook may bypass the chat's routing. Device-day check H2a decides.
